title: Silent Automatic Updates
changes: Added automatic Service Worker update checks shortly after launch, every 15 minutes, when the app returns to the foreground and when connectivity returns.
New Stats releases activate silently and reload the app once so administrators no longer need a hard refresh to receive updates.
Added a session reload guard to prevent update reload loops.
Preserved authenticated sessions, language preference and all existing analytics data during app updates.

title: Data Restoration Hotfix
changes: Fixed a malformed collector_metrics D1 CREATE TABLE statement introduced in v1.2.0.
Restored dashboard access to the existing D1 analytics data without deleting or recreating historical events.
Restored collector writes so new Hub events continue to be recorded.
Added validation to prevent the collector_metrics schema from shipping with an unclosed CREATE TABLE definition.

title: Intelligence, Executive Reporting & Data Quality
changes: Added executive snapshots with period comparisons, top source/action and peak activity insights.
Added hourly and weekday activity analysis using Eastern Time.
Expanded professional print/PDF reports to include all analytics sections.
Added data-quality reporting for received, stored, duplicate, rejected and delayed events.
Added collector-side quality counters without storing visitor names, raw IP addresses or precise location.
Expanded CSV export with activity and data-quality sections.
Improved campaign results sorting by activity while preserving zero-activity campaigns.
Refreshed the Stats PWA cache and runtime release metadata to v1.2.0.

title: Cache Reliability & Smart Navigation
changes: Version-pinned runtime asset filenames prevent browsers from mixing CSS and JavaScript from different Hub releases.
Service Worker cache reads are isolated by cache and release; old MPDGI caches are purged automatically and critical assets are rebuilt from fresh network responses.
The church address is now tappable: Apple Maps is used on iPhone/iPad and Google Maps directions on Android and desktop.
Copyright automatically grows from 2026 to 2026–current year and safely stays at 2026 if the device clock reports an earlier or invalid year.
No visual redesign: the approved v1.4.6 layout, cards and Giving presentation are preserved.
Fixed the About modal so its copyright uses the same automatic year-range formatter as the footer.

title: Payment Logo Rendering Hotfix
changes: Restored the exact inline payment-logo rendering that was visually approved in v1.4.4.
Fixed broken or distorted card-network, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Cash App Pay marks introduced by v1.4.5.
Kept the v1.4.5 accessibility, caching, Chromium, WebKit and production-smoke improvements.
Removed external payment-logo files from the Service Worker runtime cache.

title: Maintenance, Compatibility & Code Cleanup
changes: Added js/version.js as the shared runtime release version for the app and Service Worker.
Moved social and payment brand SVGs out of app.js into self-hosted local assets, reducing the main JavaScript payload.
Removed unused icon-512.svg, dead primary-button CSS, unused Zelle SVG code and unused route metadata.
Changed config and links caching to stale-while-revalidate for faster startup on slow connections.
Added WebKit QA, Chromium offline reload coverage and bilingual accessibility-label tests.
Added a post-deployment production smoke check in the main QA pipeline for hub.mpdgi.org.
Updated CI to Node 24, actions/checkout v7, actions/setup-node v7, Playwright 1.63.0 and Lighthouse 13.5.0.
Synchronized package, runtime and configuration release metadata to v1.4.5 without changing the approved visual layout.
Scoped WebKit to a focused mobile smoke suite so cross-browser coverage remains fast and stable.
Runs WebKit smoke tests against the deployed HTTPS domain so production CSP is tested without weakening local security policy.

title: TikTok & Social Brand Refresh
changes: Added the official MPDGI TikTok profile to Redes Sociales / Social Media: https://www.tiktok.com/@mpdginc.
Updated Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok buttons with recognizable platform logo shapes and brand colors.
Changed the social modal to clean white brand buttons for clearer logo recognition and consistency with the polished giving experience.
Updated bilingual social labels, external-service disclosure, README, automated QA and release validation.

title: Giving UX & Digital Wallets
changes: Added Apple Pay, Google Pay and Cash App Pay branding under the Square giving option.
Improved the Square and Tithe.ly provider lockups so each payment option is easier to recognize at a glance.
Expanded Zelle instructions with a direct five-step bank-app flow for adding the official MPDGI email recipient.
Increased Zelle email size, contrast and copy-button clarity for easier mobile use.
Kept Zelle as a bank-app workflow instead of adding a QR code that would be inconvenient when the Hub and bank app are used on the same phone.
Added automated QA and validation for the new digital-wallet and Zelle instruction experience.

title: Square Giving & Payment Branding
changes: Added the official MPDGI Square donation link to Ofrendar / Give.
Added branded Tithe.ly, Square and Zelle presentation inside the giving modal.
Added accepted-card branding for Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB and UnionPay.
Kept all giving options inside the existing Ofrendar / Give card so the Hub remains an eight-card compact layout.
Added automated QA and validation for the Square URL, giving methods and payment-brand presentation.

title: Custom Domain Activation
changes: Activated hub.mpdgi.org as the official MPDGI Hub custom domain.
Added the GitHub Pages CNAME configuration for hub.mpdgi.org.
Changed canonical, Open Graph, Twitter, Hub and NFC URLs to https://hub.mpdgi.org/.
Kept the previous GitHub Pages address documented as a legacy fallback.
Updated validation so releases require the custom domain and CNAME configuration.

title: Production Hardening & Compatibility
changes: Moved the PWA install action from the footer into Acerca de / About and only shows it when installation is available.
Improved very-short-screen readability by hiding card subtitles before shrinking primary labels further.
Made silent Service Worker updates defer the automatic reload while a modal is open or the app is backgrounded.
Corrected bilingual labels, including Acerca de in Spanish and English accessibility text in English mode.
Added modal background inert handling for stronger keyboard and screen-reader isolation.
Added dynamic viewport units, PNG install icons, Apple Touch Icon usage, manifest language/direction metadata and a 1200x630 social sharing card.
Set hub.mpdgi.org as the planned permanent custom domain while keeping the current GitHub Pages NFC URL active until DNS is intentionally configured.
Added automated mobile viewport, modal, language, link, overflow, console, Lighthouse and recursive secret-scan checks.

title: Color & Header Polish
changes: Changed the About card from gray to a distinct burgundy tone so no two menu cards share the same gray treatment.
Increased the official church logo slightly.
Added more breathing room between the church name and the scripture block.
Moved the Designed & Developed credit slightly lower and increased its font size by about one point.

title: Spacing, Silent Updates & NFC Readiness
changes: Added space below Matthew 20:28 before the divider line.
Added space between the divider line and the menu grid.
Added space between the final menu row and the yellow wave.
Enabled silent Service Worker updates for existing installations: new versions activate automatically and the app reloads once without an update prompt.
Added periodic and foreground update checks with updateViaCache disabled for the Service Worker script.
Declared and validated the current NFC/QR production target as https://kl4ne.github.io/mpdgi-hub/.

title: Balanced Vertical Spacing
changes: Added a little more vertical breathing room between menu rows while keeping the compact button height.
Kept the horizontal gap tight so the two-column layout remains efficient.
Preserved the single-screen mobile target and all v1.3.0 functionality.

title: About Card & Ultra Compact Grid
changes: Changed Sitio Web / Website from a full-width card to the same size as the other Hub cards.
Added an About card beside Website and moved the existing About modal information into that card.
Removed the footer About button and visible version badge; the version remains available inside About.
Moved the Designed & Developed credit upward by simplifying the footer.
Reduced all card heights and internal spacing again to improve one-glance mobile fit.

title: Tighter Header & Cards
changes: Reduced the empty space above the official logo.
Reduced the card height and internal padding slightly so more of the Hub fits in one mobile viewport.
Tightened the short-screen responsive rules without removing content or changing any current Hub features.

title: Single-Screen Compact Layout
changes: Condensed the hero/header so the logo, church name, motto and scripture use substantially less vertical space.
Reduced card height, gaps and icon footprint while preserving touch targets and readability.
Shortened the decorative wave, church information strip and footer.
Kept the seven-card two-column layout even on narrower phones to avoid unnecessary vertical scrolling.
Added extra compact rules for shorter phone screens so the main Hub is designed to fit in a single viewport on common mobile sizes.

title: Bible & Footer Refresh
changes: Removed the four-item bottom navigation and restored the compact v1.0.0-style footer with version, install, About, developer credit and copyright.
Replaced Conéctate with a bilingual Biblia / Bible card.
Added a Bible modal with Reina-Valera 1960 (RVR1960) in Spanish and King James Version (KJV) in English through BibleGateway.
Redes Sociales now uses recognizable Facebook, Instagram and YouTube brand marks with platform names and no Abrir/Open wording.
Replaced the previous mockup-like card icons with a cleaner custom monoline icon system.
Kept Zelle centered, Ministerios linked to https://mpdgi.org/ministerios, and YouTube inside Redes Sociales.
Kept Servicio en Vivo, Eventos and Recursos removed.

title: Reference UI Refresh
changes: Restored the official MPdG logo and refreshed the interface toward the approved mobile reference.

title: NFC Launch
changes: First public release of MPDGI Hub.
